name: type: bug
description: Unexpected behavior, or a PR that fixes it.

name: type: feature
description: New functionality or an improvement to the user experience.

name: type: docs
description: Documentation changes.

name: type: refactor
description: Code restructuring that preserves existing behavior.

name: type: chore
description: Dependencies, builds, CI, and repository maintenance.

name: status: triage
description: New feedback awaiting evaluation and confirmation.

name: status: backlog
description: Accepted work that is not yet scheduled.

name: status: todo
description: Planned for the near term, but not yet started.

name: status: in-progress
description: Work has started, including implementation, verification, and PR review.

name: area: agent
description: Conversations, prompt input, agent execution, context, and tools.

name: area: canvas
description: Design and Asset Canvas, documents, nodes, and the Asset Library.

name: area: models
description: Providers, model configuration and authentication, and media generation.

name: area: story
description: Interactive Story editing, scene graphs, state, and navigation.

name: area: runtime
description: Game execution, previews, playtesting, and project processes.

name: area: desktop
description: Desktop windows, installation, startup, and updates.

name: area: publish
description: Publishing, sharing, and Community integration.

name: area: plugins
description: Plugins, Skills, and MCP installation and management.

name: area: ui
description: General interface, project navigation, themes, and internationalization.

name: priority: urgent
description: Requires immediate attention: severe data loss or widespread inability to run.

name: priority: high
description: Prioritize this work because a core workflow is significantly affected.

name: good first issue
description: A well-defined task suitable for a first-time contributor.

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers welcome community contributions to this work.

name: duplicate
description: Already tracked elsewhere; link the original issue or PR before closing.

name: flag: needs-info
description: More information or a reproducible example is needed.

name: flag: blocked
description: A concrete dependency or obstacle prevents progress; explain it in a comment.
